messages:
maria: ACME (tenant acme-42) reporting repeated 429s - "rate_limit_exceeded" on Dedicated pool ded-nyc-3. Started ~2026-09-07T17:15:00Z. Customer says throughput dropped and autoscaler didn't scale.

maria: quick log snip:
```
2026-09-07T17:15:21Z WARN throttle tenant=acme-42 pool=ded-nyc-3 reason=rate_limit_exceeded count=1
2026-09-07T17:15:22Z WARN throttle tenant=acme-42 pool=ded-nyc-3 reason=rate_limit_exceeded count=187
2026-09-07T17:16:00Z ERROR request id=... status=429 body="QuotaExceeded"
```

lee: What's the tenant quota object? Any recent quota updates or migrations?

maria: I pulled the quota object from control-plane API:
```
GET /internal/tenants/acme-42/quota
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-42",
  "pool": "ded-nyc-3",
  "quota": {
    "unit": "requests_per_minute",
    "limit": 50000
  }
}
```
Runtime throttle logs show it's evaluating in tokens/min. I suspect a unit mismatch: UI/config stores requests_per_minute but the limiter counts tokens_per_minute -> each request counts as full token budget.

ops-bot: ALERT ded-nyc-3: tenant=acme-42 throttle_spike=220 window=5m

jordan: Can you confirm the limiter version? migration 2026-09-07 had a change to quota schema. Run on pool leader:
```
ssh ded-nyc-3-leader
curl -s http://localhost:8080/debug/quota/acme-42
```

kai: Short mitigation: temporarily increase tenant quota to avoid customer impact and reload quota cache. Command:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://controlplane.internal/api/tenants/acme-42/quota" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"quota": {"unit":"tokens_per_minute","limit":2000000}}'

# then trigger reload on pool
curl -X POST "https://infra.internal/pools/ded-nyc-3/reload-quota" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN"
```

lee: I'll run a quick canary to reproduce and confirm no global regressions:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TENANT_TOKEN" \
  "https://ded-nyc-3.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" &
done
```

maria: After bump+reload we see 429s drop to near zero, customer confirms normal traffic. Monitoring shows no visible spike in cost; autoscaler behaved normally once limiter stopped blocking requests. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Root cause: migration script swapped/renamed quota fields for a subset of tenants during deploy (requests_per_minute stored where tokens_per_minute expected). Filed INF-6421 to add schema validation and a migration rollback plan. Also adding an integration test to catch unit mismatches.

kai: Long-term: add unit field validation, and UI copy to avoid "requests" vs "tokens" ambiguity. Also add a post-deploy quota-check job.

maria: I'll follow-up with customer summary and SLA note. Thanks all.
